n = int(input())
B = int(input())

arr = [int(input()) for _ in range(n)]

evenCount = 0
oddCount = 0
diffList = []

for i in range(n):
    if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    if evenCount == oddCount and i < n - 1:
        diffList.append(abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]))

diffList.sort()

count = 0
for diff in diffList:
    if B < diff:
        break
    count += 1
    B -= diff

print(count)
</translated_code>
